The root equations and derivative equation analytically give x_-=L+log L+o(1), x_m=L+2log L+o(1), x_+=1/rho+1+o(1), and min R=-rho/L(1+o(1)). value.rationale: Positivity and all-step energy dissipation are distinct safeguards for positive semigroup time integration. An exact bounded intermediate-step sign-failure window for a well-known second-order ETDRK method, with logarithmic onset, reciprocal closing step, and quantified minimum depth, gives practically relevant split-dependent positivity diagnostics and a structural boundary not supplied by published stability theorems; it is not a renaming or mere known stability-region computation.
